name: Plantain Pancakes
ingredients:
100g flour
1 egg
1 plantain
2 tablespoons of milk (use your instincts)
2 tablespoons of sugar (use your instincts)
50ml of water (more or less)
½ tablespoon of baking powder
notes: No. 1 in the book — 'use your instincts' on the milk and sugar.

name: Minced Wrap
ingredients:
Dough:
120g flour
3 tablespoons of vegetable oil
Some thyme, herbs etc.
Half teaspoon of salt
Water (as needed)
Filling:
Some minced meat
Turmeric / curry
Spice as required
steps:
Make the dough with flour, oil, thyme, herbs, salt and water as needed.
Season the minced meat with turmeric, curry and spice as required, then fry.
Fill the dough with the fried mince and cook.

name: Curried Ham Sauce
ingredients:
Oil
Ham (mashed) / minced meat / corned beef
Curry
Pepper
Thyme
Salt
Maggi / seasoning cubes
steps: Prepare like stew.
notes: No. 3 in the book — ham, minced meat or corned beef all work.

name: Ethel & Praise Special Rice (Vegetable Rice)
ingredients:
Rice
Ugwu / pumpkin leaves
Onions
Pepper
Salt
Curry
Maggi / seasoning cube
steps:
Boil rice with curry and a lot of salt and Maggi.
Fry onions, then the leaves, then pepper, salt and Maggi.
Add rice to the vegetable mix and add a little oil till it cooks.

name: Ginger Stew
ingredients:
Stew
Ginger
steps: Make stew as usual and add ginger.
notes: No. 5 in the book — simply: stew + ginger.

name: Ginger Rice
ingredients:
Rice (fried or jollof)
Ginger
steps: Make fried or jollof rice and add ginger.
notes: No. 6 in the book — simply: rice (fried/jollof) + ginger.

name: Chin Chin
ingredients:
1kg flour
150g of milk / 150ml
275g of sugar
Nutmeg
250g of margarine
Oil (for frying)
notes: No. 7 in the book. Smaller batch: 500g flour, 75g/ml of milk, 200g of sugar, 100g of margarine, nutmeg, oil.

name: Jollof Rice
ingredients:
1.5kg of fresh tomatoes
600g of tinned tomatoes / 1.2kg of pureed
Vegetable oil
1 onion
Stock
Rice
Salt
Pepper
steps:
Blend fresh tomatoes and pureed tomatoes, and heat on low heat till drained of water.
Boil rice separately.
Add oil, onions and tinned tomato.
Fry at low heat — the tomato stew is ready.
Pour stock and stew into pot and leave to boil.
Add rice, salt and pepper.

name: Giz-dodo
ingredients:
Gizzard (1 pack)
Plantain (4)
Tomatoes (3) & tomato paste
Atarodo (2)
Bell pepper (3)
Garlic (1 clove or powder)
Onions
Curry
2 Knorr
Oil
steps:
Boil gizzard with onion, garlic, 1 Knorr, curry and salt.
Fry plantain (cut in cubes).
Fry gizzard (till brown).
Blend tomatoes and atarodo, fry with sliced onions, add 1 Knorr and salt — has to be a thick sauce.
Add gizzard to sauce, then plantain, onions and bell peppers.

name: Order for Stir Fry
ingredients:
Oil
Onion
Garlic
Spices
Ginger
Mushroom
Prawn
Soy sauce
steps:
Oil.
Onion.
Garlic.
Spices.
Ginger.
Mushroom.
Prawn.
Soy sauce.
notes: No. 10 in the book — her flow chart for the order things go into a stir fry.

name: Snails
ingredients:
Snails
Scent leaves
Tomatoes (2)
Tomato puree
Dry pepper
Garlic
Onions
Knorr (1)
Spices
steps:
Wash snails with lime.
Boil snails till tender.
Fry blended tomatoes + puree + onions + garlic + Knorr + scent leaves + spices + dry pepper + salt.
Mix in snails and leave for a bit.

name: Fried Rice (quick notes)
ingredients:
Oil
Onions
Veggies
Stock
Pepper
Salt
Knorr
Prawns
Rice
steps:
Oil + onions + veggies.
Stock + pepper + salt + Knorr + prawns.
Rice.
notes: No. 12 in the book — marked 'not detailed'.

name: Catfish / Pepper Soup
ingredients:
Catfish
Knorr cubes
Onions
Salt
Scent leaves
1 tsp oil
Pepper
Crayfish
steps:
Boil hot water, pour on fish, stir and remove immediately (toughens fish).
Put water in pot (enough to just cover the fish).
Add Knorr cubes + onions + salt + scent leaves.
Add 1 tsp oil + pepper + crayfish.
Allow to boil.

name: Prawn Sauce
ingredients:
Oil
Onions
Curry
Yellow pepper
Garlic
Ginger
Coriander
Salt
Tomato
Chilli
Prawns
Lemon juice
Fresh coriander (garnish)
steps:
Heat oil.
Add onions, add curry, add yellow pepper, add garlic, add ginger, add coriander, add salt.
Add tomato, add chilli, add prawns and water.
Add lemon juice.
Garnish with fresh coriander.

name: Prawn in Batter
ingredients:
Prawns
Knorr, salt & pepper
Batter mix
Egg
Salt
Curry
Pepper
All purpose seasoning
Knorr [?]
steps:
Boil prawn a bit, for like 2 minutes. Add Knorr, salt and pepper.
Mix batter mix, egg, salt, curry, pepper, all purpose seasoning, Knorr [?].
Dip prawn in batter and fry.
notes: No. 15 in the book — the Knorr in the batter has a question mark in her writing.

name: Fried Rice
ingredients:
Rice
Chicken stock (or stock pot)
Onions
Thyme
Curry & salt
Liver
Mixed veg
Oil
Knorr
Pepper
Garlic powder [?]
All spices [?]
steps:
Per-boil rice (not too soft).
Boil again with chicken stock (or stock pot), onions, thyme, curry and salt.
Keep rice to the side.
Prepare liver — cut it a bit, then boil with some salt, Knorr and pepper (cut them).
Maybe boil the mixed veg a little bit (like a minute or less).
Divide vegetables and liver into different portions for frying with the different portions of rice.
Pour small oil, Knorr, pepper, salt, curry, garlic powder [?], all spices [?].
Pour vegetables and liver in it. Sauté for a bit.
Pour rice in, stir and fry.

name: Stir-Fry Rice
ingredients:
Dry beef (shredded)
Onions
Oil
Pepper
Salt
Curry
Garlic powder
Mixed spices
All purpose spice
Sweet chilli
Rice (boiled)
steps:
Shred dry beef, cut onions.
Pour oil, add onions, pepper, salt, curry, garlic powder, mixed spices, all purpose spice.
Add sweet chilli.
Add rice (boiled), stir and fry.

name: Palm Oil Jollof Rice
ingredients:
Rice
Palm oil
Onions
Garlic
Pepper
Salt
Knorr or Maggi
All purpose seasoning
Stock (or stock pot)
Dry fish
Crayfish
steps:
Per-boil rice (not too soft).
Put palm oil in a pot, heat it.
Add onions, garlic, pepper, salt, Knorr or Maggi, all purpose seasoning, stock (or stock pot), dry fish, crayfish.
Add the rice (maybe small water if the stock water isn't enough).

name: Yam Porridge
ingredients:
Yam
Salt
Water
Plantain
Palm oil
Chopped onions
Ground crayfish
Pepper
Knorr cubes
Dried fish
Sliced vegetables
steps:
Cut and peel yam. Rinse and put in the pot.
Also add salt and water, boil for like ten minutes. Then add plantain.
Leave for like 5 more minutes; add palm oil, chopped onions, ground crayfish, pepper, Knorr cubes, dried fish.
Cook till yam is tender-ish.
Add sliced vegetables, mix, allow to simmer for like 5 minutes.

name: Chapman
ingredients:
160ml Fanta
160ml Sprite
3 tablespoons of Ribena [?]
½ cup grenadine syrup (25ml?)
10ml Angostura
Campari? (teaspoon)
steps: Mix everything together over ice.
notes: No. 20 in the book — her own question marks on the Ribena, grenadine and Campari amounts.

name: Efo Riro Stew
ingredients:
Shaki
Knorr, salt, curry, dry pepper, thyme
Chopped onions
Pepper, tomatoes, onion, ginger root & garlic (to blend)
Veg oil
(Tinned) tomato puree
Stockfish & dry fish
Palm oil
Maggi
Meat stock
All purpose seasoning
Your meat
Spinach (fresh or frozen)
steps:
Boil shaki with Knorr, salt, curry, dry pepper, thyme and chopped onions till tender.
Blend pepper, tomatoes, onion, ginger root and garlic.
Add veg oil, put in blended mixture, Knorr, (tinned) tomato puree, salt; let it dry for a bit into a stew.
Boil stockfish and dry fish till a bit tender.
Put palm oil in a pot, add some chopped onions, then add the stew; add Maggi, thyme, meat stock, curry and all purpose seasoning.
Let it cook for a bit. Add your meat.
Let it cook for another 10 minutes.
Add spinach (chopped — or if you're using frozen spinach squeeze out all the water and tear it a bit).
Ta-da.
notes: No. 21 in the book — ends with 'Ta-da'.

name: Vegetable & Shrimp Sauce
ingredients:
Oil
Onions (sliced)
Shrimps
Pepper (fresh)
Stock cube
Salt
Black pepper
Dry pepper
Ugu
steps:
Pour oil in pan.
Add onions (sliced) and shrimps.
Remove shrimp when brown but add more onions to oil.
Add (fresh) pepper, stock cube, salt, black pepper, dry pepper.
Stir and add ugu.
Add shrimp again and voila.
notes: No. 22 in the book — ends with 'voila'.

name: Coconut Rice
ingredients:
Coconut oil
Onions
Pepper (fresh)
Coconut milk
2 cups water
Maggi
Spices
Chicken stock
Salt
Rice (parboiled)
Crayfish
steps:
Coconut oil + onions, then + pepper (fresh).
Add coconut milk, 2 cups water, Maggi, spices, chicken stock and salt.
Let it boil.
Add rice (parboiled) + crayfish. Let it cook.

name: Stew
ingredients:
Pepper (atarodo)
Bell pepper
Onion
Tomatoes
Palm oil + vegetable oil
Meat
Spices
Stock
steps:
Blend pepper (atarodo) + bell pepper + onion + tomatoes.
Heat palm oil + vegetable oil.
Fry meat a bit then take it out (flavours oil).
Fry onions a bit.
Add blended mix + spices (leave for a bit till oil starts coming up).
Add stock.
Add meat.
When oil settles on top, it's done.

name: Jollof Rice #2
ingredients:
4 cups of rice
3 large bell peppers
2/3 tomatoes
1 scotch bonnet (or ½)
Beef
Tomato paste (120g)
2 onions
1 tablespoon of minced ginger
2 tablespoons of butter
½ teaspoon of curry & thyme
½ teaspoon of any other seasoning
3 Knorr chicken cubes
2 teaspoons of white pepper
3 bay leaves
steps:
Blend bell peppers + atarodo + tomato + onions.
Heat oil and add sliced onions.
Add blended mix + tomato paste + Knorr cubes + curry powder + white pepper (1 teaspoon) + bay leaves — let it fry.
Par boil rice for 8 minutes (maybe at the beginning).
Add stock to the frying mix, let it heat.
Add the rice, mix well, let stew cover rice.
Add butter + minced ginger + white pepper (1 teaspoon).
Let it cook, check on it occasionally to see what to add.

name: Corned Beef Sauce
ingredients:
400g corned beef
1 cup tomatoes chopped (1 round)
1 tsp curry
½ tsp thyme
1 seasoning cube
Dry pepper
1 onion
Carrots, peas, green pepper
½ cup veg oil
1 egg
steps:
Heat oil.
Add onions (fry for 1 minute).
Add tomatoes, add corned beef. Cook for 5 mins.
Add curry, thyme, pepper, seasoning cube and vegetables.
Beat in eggs, leave for one minute.
Add water if necessary.

name: Buns
ingredients:
150g plain flour
½ teaspoon baking powder
2 tablespoons milk
1 tablespoon of sugar
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp nutmeg
Warm water
notes: No. 27 in the book — ingredients only; see also New Buns Recipe (No. 53).

name: Steak
ingredients:
Steak
Olive oil
Salt
Garlic powder
Thyme
Black pepper
(Maybe all purpose seasoning)
Garlic clove
Butter
steps:
Rub in: olive oil, salt, garlic powder, thyme and black pepper to either side (maybe all purpose seasoning).
Add to a hot pan. Cook for about one minute on each side and flip it.
Halve a garlic clove (and crush it) and rub it over the steak every time you turn it to give it flavour.
Rub butter over it each time you turn it as well.
Remove at your own discretion.
notes: No. 28 in the book — 'remove at your own discretion'.

name: Pancakes
ingredients:
100g flour
1 egg
225ml milk
Sugar to taste
Sprinkle of salt

name: Liver Sauce
ingredients:
Liver
Tomatoes
Garlic
Onions
Bell pepper
Oil
Tomato puree
Spices (Knorr cubes, salt, thyme, all purpose spice, garlic)
steps:
Boil liver. Then blend it till it's as fine as possible.
Blend in tomatoes, garlic, onions and bell pepper.
Heat up the blended mix till it loses most of its water.
Add some oil to it, then some tomato puree.
Add spices and blended liver in.
Add a few chopped bell peppers.
You're good to go.

name: Potato Sauce
ingredients:
1 big potato
Onions
Broccoli & cauliflower
Stock (or water and stock pot)
Oil
Spices to taste
steps:
Blend one big potato till it's as fine as possible.
Cut onions, broccoli and cauliflower and keep to the side.
Heat up stock (or water and stock pot).
Add broccoli and cauliflower, let boil.
Add chopped up potato and onions.
Add a bit of oil.
Add spices to taste.
notes: No. 31 in the book — cabbage, carrots and bell peppers can be added.

name: Fried Rice (in portions)
ingredients:
Meat or chicken (for stock)
Parboiled rice
Curry
White pepper
Knorr cubes
Boiled liver (chopped)
Sweet corn, peas & mixed veg
Vegetable oil
Diced onions
Salt
Small Maggi
steps:
Boil meat or chicken and keep stock, or mix stock pot and water (sieve stock).
Boil parboiled rice with stock, curry, white pepper and maybe Knorr cubes till it's soft (but not too soft).
Have chopped up boiled liver, sweet corn, peas and mixed veg basically.
Divide into equal portions to fit the rice portions.
Pour small vegetable oil into a frying pan; add diced onions, one portion of the veg-liver mix, curry, white pepper, salt and small Maggi.
Mix, then add one portion of rice.
Stir till all the ingredients are mixed well and then transfer to a plate or pot.
Repeat till all the rice is done.
notes: No. 32 in the book — fried in portions.

name: Curry Sauce
ingredients:
1 onion
1 potato
1 carrot
800ml of water
Prawns
4-5 blocks of Japanese curry roux
steps:
Cut onion, potato and carrot into small chunks and add to a pot filled with 800ml of water.
Simmer for a bit, don't let vegetables boil too much. Add prawns and let them boil as well.
Add 4-5 blocks of Japanese curry roux to the water, reduce the heat to low.
Keep mixing the blocks in till the curry sauce is thick and smooth.

name: Egg Roll
ingredients:
2 cups of flour
1 beaten egg
1 tsp baking powder
¼ tsp salt
½ tsp nutmeg
2 tbsp margarine
8-9 tbsp water
4/5 boiled eggs
Sugar
steps:
Mix flour, baking powder, salt, sugar and nutmeg.
Use your fingers to blend the margarine into the flour until it's crumbly.
Add the beaten egg and mix.
Add water and mix. Work the dough.
Work the dough and wrap around egg.
Fry.

name: Banga Stew
ingredients:
800g tinned palm fruit
1kg beef
3 pieces of dried fish
Scent leaves
1 red onion
Crayfish
Habanero pepper
Salt
Oil [?]
Stock cubes
steps:
Add beef + dry fish + onions + stock cubes.
Pour water to same level as contents.
Or: boil raw beef with usual stuff.
Add fish to beef and stock.
Add pepper + crayfish + ogiri okpei [?].
Stir well and add banga concentrate (add more water if necessary).
(Can add fish here instead of earlier.)
Add scent leaves and salt.
notes: No. 35 in the book — one word before 'okpei' is hard to read.

name: Native Jollof Rice
ingredients:
Rice
Palm oil
Onion
Pepper
Dried fish
Ponmo [?]
Crayfish
Locust bean
Ugwu / scent leaf
Stock
Salt
Stock cubes
steps:
Preheat palm oil on a medium heat.
Add diced onion and fry.
Stir in the locust bean and fry for about a few seconds.
Add peppers and fry until it's reduced.
Add crayfish, dry fish, ponmo, salt and stock cube.
Add stock and water, cover it up.
Stir in the rice and cook until done.
Stir in the ugwu and palm oil.

name: Corn Bread
ingredients:
125g plain flour
125g corn meal
140g sugar
1 tsp salt
3 tsps baking powder
1 egg
235ml milk
50ml vegetable oil
steps:
Preheat oven to 200°C.
Lightly grease oven pan (9 inch round works).
Mix all dry ingredients then add egg, milk, oil/melted butter (mix liquid ones together first).
Pour in baking tin and bake for 20-25 minutes.
notes: No. 37 in the book. Alternative batch: ¼ cup butter, 1 cup milk, 1 egg, 1¼ cup corn meal, 1 cup flour, ½ cup sugar, 1 tbsp baking powder, ½ tsp salt.

name: Jollof Rice #3
ingredients:
Plum tomatoes
Tin tomatoes
Vegetable oil
Onions
Rice
Chicken / beef
Pepper & salt
Knorr cubes
Thyme
Curry powder
steps:
Blend fresh tomatoes (can add blended onions and bell peppers [?]).
Pour blended mix in pot and dry water.
Add tin tomatoes, oil and chopped onions.
Let fry till you like the taste.
Mix tomato mix and stock (beef/chicken), leave to boil.
Add parboiled rice, curry, salt, pepper (and water if needed).
Cover and leave to cook.

name: Fried Rice #2
ingredients:
Rice
Mixed veg (carrot, sweet corn, peas & green beans — better to use fresh carrot)
Green onions
Curry
Thyme
Chicken
Stock cube
Oil for frying (enough)
Salt & white pepper
steps:
Boil chicken stock and parboiled rice.
Add 2 tablespoons of oil in frying pan, sauté the onions, then add mixed veg and seasoning (thyme, curry, salt, pepper and stock cube).
Add rice, stir fry for about 2 minutes.
Done.

name: Stew #2
ingredients:
Tomatoes
Bell peppers
Onions
Ata-rodo
Meat / chicken
Salt
Curry & thyme
Oil
Knorr
steps:
Boil meat/chicken with onions, thyme, salt and Knorr to make stock.
Chop tomatoes, bell peppers, onions and atarodo in big chunks.
Roast for 45-60 mins / grill / boil for 15 mins till they look a bit dehydrated.
Blend everything (should be thick-ish — if it's too watery, put in pot and dry out water a bit).
Put meat/chicken stock on fire. Add blended mix. Let boil for a bit.
Add meat/chicken. Add Knorr and salt if needed. Cook for 10 mins.
Add oil, curry, thyme. Let simmer for 10 mins (or till oil floats to the top).
Done.

name: Plantain Moi Moi
ingredients:
2 pcs of overripe plantain
100g plantain flour
Palm oil
1 teaspoon ground crayfish
1 onion
1 Knorr cube
Pepper & salt
steps:
Put plantain flour in a bowl and mix with water till it's at medium consistency (not too thick).
Blend plantain, flour batter, onions, crayfish, pepper and stock cube.
Add salt and palm oil (mix well).
Wrap in either uma leaves (2 per wrap) or foil.
Steam in pot/steamer for 25-50 minutes.

name: Okpa
ingredients:
450g okpa flour
15 tablespoons red palm oil
4 stock cubes
Salt
Habanero pepper (chopped up in chunks)
1.2 litres lukewarm water
steps:
Sift flour into a big bowl.
Add salt and crushed stock cubes.
Add palm oil, mix well till properly incorporated.
Add lukewarm water to the mix till there aren't lumps.
Add sliced habanero.
Boil water in pot for steaming.
Pour mix in wrapper, tie and put in pot and boil.
Cook for at least 1 hr.

name: Spicy Pepper Sauce (1)
ingredients:
3 mixed bell peppers
1 cooking spoon vegetable oil
1 small onion, chopped
2 scotch bonnet
3 cloves garlic
2 teaspoons curry powder
1 teaspoon thyme
1 Knorr chicken cube
1 teaspoon chicken seasoning
Salt
steps:
Blend bell peppers, scotch bonnet and garlic coarsely.
Heat up oil, add chopped onions.
Add curry.
Add coarse blend.
Add thyme, Knorr cube, chicken seasoning. Fry for 15, stir.
Reduce heat and fry for 15 more minutes.

name: Spicy Turkey / Chicken Veggie Sauce
ingredients:
400g diced boneless turkey/chicken
1.5 tablespoon of corn flour/starch
5 tablespoons soy sauce
½ cup chicken stock
1 green bell pepper (chopped)
1 red bell pepper (chopped)
2 carrots, chopped
3 sprigs spring onions, chopped
1 small onion
2 teaspoon ginger paste
2 teaspoon garlic paste
4 tablespoons vegetable oil
Curry powder, dried thyme, paprika powder, garlic powder, onion powder, Knorr chicken cube, salt
steps:
Season turkey with 2 tsp garlic and onion powder, 1 Knorr chicken cube, 1 tsp chicken seasoning, 1 tsp curry powder and thyme, 1 tsp corn flour. Combine and leave to marinate for at least 1 hr.
Mix corn flour, stock and soy sauce. Set aside.
Heat veg oil, add seasoned turkey. Fry until well cooked.
Add chopped onions, combine, then fry for 2 minutes.
Add ginger and garlic paste.
Add chopped peppers, scotch bonnet (or dry pepper), carrots, spring onion. Fry for 3 mins.
Add 1 tsp curry, 2 tsp paprika.
Add soy sauce, stock and corn flour mix.
Fry for 2 mins and sauce is ready.

name: Grilled Tilapia
ingredients:
1 medium sized tilapia
2 tbs veg oil
1 tsp garlic powder
½ tsp onion powder
½ tsp ginger powder
½ tsp cumin powder
1 tsp cayenne pepper
1 Knorr chicken cube
¼ tsp fish / chicken / all purpose seasoning
steps:
Pre-heat oven to 180°C.
Clean and descale fish.
Mix all the ingredients together.
Rub half the marinade on fish. Make cuts on fish and rub marinade in.
Leave to marinate for at least 1hr. Rub more on the fish after it's done marinating.
Place on oven rack, place in oven and grill for 15 mins on each side (remember to turn the fish over and rub more marinade on it if needed).

name: Pepper Sauce (2)
ingredients:
1 red bell pepper
2 tomatoes
1 scotch bonnet
½ cooking spoon of vegetable oil
Onions (chopped)
1 Knorr cube
Curry powder
Thyme
Salt
steps:
Blend 1 red bell pepper, 2 tomatoes, 1 scotch bonnet coarsely.
Heat ½ cooking spoon of vegetable oil.
Add chopped onions, sautée and then add blended mix.
Add 1 Knorr cube, curry powder, thyme and salt.
Fry for 15 minutes.

name: Spicy Grilled Fish
ingredients:
1 medium sized tilapia
1 inch root ginger
½ tsp dried thyme
½ tsp dried rosemary
1 tbsp cayenne pepper
6 garlic cloves
1 tsp lime juice
1 red bell pepper
1 scotch bonnet
1 medium onion
2 tbs pepper flakes
3 Knorr cubes
Salt
2 tbs olive oil
steps:
Clean fish, make deep incisions on fish.
Blend thyme, rosemary, cayenne pepper, 3 garlic cloves, 1 tsp lemon juice, ½ of the ginger, 2 tbs olive oil and ½ onion.
Add crushed pepper flakes.
Rub half the marinade on the fish and in the incisions and leave for at least 2 hrs (or overnight).
Add bell pepper, scotch bonnet, rest of garlic and ginger into blender (blend roughly).
Pour 1 cooking spoon oil into a pan, add ½ chopped onion, sauté till fragrant.
Add blended mix, Knorr cubes and salt to taste.
Fry for 15 mins on low heat. Oil will settle on top. Discard the excess oil.
When fish is done marinating, place in oven on grill setting @ 180°C. Grill for 5 mins, baste the fish with the fried pepper sauce.
Transfer back into oven, grill for 30-40 mins. Turn fish around for even heat distribution.
Baste some pepper sauce occasionally as well.

name: Party Fried Meat
ingredients:
500g of beef
¼ red onion
Ginger
5 cloves garlic
2 stock cubes
1 tsp thyme
½ tsp black pepper
steps:
Peel and dice garlic, ginger and ¼ onion and blend.
Cut beef into small chunks, place in bowl.
Add thyme, black pepper, stock cubes and blended mix.
Stir well, cover and place in fridge and marinate for at least 1 hr.
Place marinated beef in a pot, cover and leave to steam on medium heat.
Stir and monitor so it doesn't burn.
When it becomes pale with no blood, remove.
Pour some veg oil into pot, heat — add onion chunk — add beef and fry.
When beef is golden take off oil and you're done.

name: Uwho Soup
ingredients:
Assorted meat: shaki, beef, ponmo, snails, stockfish, dry fish, isam [?]
Palm oil
Edible potash (2 teaspoons)
½ cup garri
2 stock cubes
steps:
Cook meats and stockfish with stock cube till soft.
Soak dry and stockfish to soften.
Mix potash and water, set aside.
Pour palm oil in a container, gently decant potash water while stirring till it turns yellow and thick.
Sieve garri, mix with stock/water and form 3/2 balls.
Add fish to the boiling meats when they're soft.
After a bit, add palm oil mix, and then add garri balls. Continue cooking. Don't cover pot.
Take garri balls out when you've achieved desired soup thickness.
It's done when soup is no longer foaming.
notes: No. 49 in the book — one meat in the list ('isam') is hard to read.

name: Tapioca
ingredients:
Cassava
Cold water
steps:
Peel and wash cassava.
Cut into about 2 inch cylindrical pieces.
Put in pot, cover in cold water and cook till hard done.
Let cool then slice.
Soak overnight in cold water.
Rinse a couple of times the next day and ready to eat.

name: Veg & Shrimp Sauce
ingredients:
10 shrimps
1 medium bowl of ugwu
2 cooking spoons veg oil
2 sweet peppers
Habanero
1 onion
2 small stock cubes
1 tsp black pepper
steps:
Dice onions, sweet pepper and habanero.
Slice ugu.
Pour oil in pan or pot.
Add diced onions.
Add shrimp and sautée for 7 mins while stirring. When brown remove shrimp and set aside.
Add remaining onion into oil and fry for 3 mins (or till slightly brown).
Add diced peppers and fry.
Crush and add stock cubes, salt and black pepper.
Stir and add sliced ugu. Stir very well.
Add fried shrimp and stir. Done.

name: Nigerian Beans
ingredients:
3 cups of beans
3½ × 3 cups of water [?]
1 medium onion + 1 onion (for blending)
Plantain
Fish
4 tbs crayfish + 1 more tbsp
1½ tbs dry pepper
Salt
4½ cubes of Knorr
Palm oil (about 5-6 red spoons)
steps:
Pour water — 3½ × 3 cups of water.
Wash 3 cups of beans with water.
Transfer the washed beans into the pot of water and boil for 1hr-1hr30 minutes.
Cut one medium sized onion into the pot as well.
Check if it's cooked (i.e. soft to par) after 1hr (add some salt).
Add plantain after 1hr 20 of beans boiling.
Add fish after 3 mins of plantain boiling.
Blend 1 onion, 4 tbs crayfish, 1½ tbs dry pepper and 2 tbs of water.
Add blended mix 4 mins after adding fish (you can add ⅓ cup water to rinse blender and add to the pot).
Add 1 more tbsp of crayfish, a bit of salt and 4½ cubes of Knorr (after 3 mins).
Add palm oil (about 5-6 of my red spoons) and after 10 mins your food is done.
notes: No. 52 in the book — 'about 5-6 of my red spoons'.

name: New Buns Recipe
ingredients:
250g flour
5g sugar
1 teaspoonful baking powder
1 egg (optional)
150ml milk (or as needed to form a thick batter)
1 tablespoon margarine
1 teaspoon of salt
steps:
Mix flour, sugar, baking powder, egg, salt, margarine and milk.
(Feel free to add more flour if you think it's too light.)
Heat up oil until moderately hot.
Scoop and fry.

name: Stew (New)
ingredients:
4-6 large tomatoes
4 red bell pepper
Green bell pepper (2)
2 large onions
1 scotch bonnet
Next set:
3 cups sauce
10-15 pieces boiled and mashed protein (beef, chicken, etc.)
1 cup meat stock
Maggi & salt
Curry & thyme
⅓ cup of oil
steps:
Chop and blend all the ingredients (can roast before blending or not) to get a sauce.
Heat sauce to remove water.
Place a large pot on medium heat and add in meat stock.
Add in sauce. Let simmer until it starts to boil.
Add in protein, taste, adjust for salt and Maggi.
Cover and leave to simmer for 10 mins.
Add in oil, curry and thyme.
Simmer for 10 mins or until oil floats to top.
Your stew is served.

name: Bukka Stew
ingredients:
Part A:
2 large red bell pepper (tatashe)
2 green bell pepper
1 large red onion
3 large tomatoes
1 scotch bonnet
Part B:
½ small red onion
Pre-cooked meat & dry fish
1 cup palm oil
3 cubes Knorr or Maggi
Salt to taste
steps:
Combine and blend everything in Part A.
Pour the blended mixture in a pot and cook to remove excess water.
Set a large pot on heat. Add half of the palm oil, bleach for about 2-5 minutes.
Add in chopped onions and fry until dark. Remove and discard the onion.
Add parboiled pureed mixture, ½-1 cup water, Knorr cubes and salt. Simmer for 15 minutes.
Reduce heat to below medium, add in pre-cooked meat and fish.
Combine, taste and adjust for seasoning.
Cover and simmer for about 10 minutes.
Add in the left over palm oil.
Cover and simmer for another 5 minutes.
The stew is ready to serve when oil floats to the top.

name: Potato Pottage
ingredients:
Chicken
Onion
Thyme
Curry
Water
Salt
Knorr
Irish potato
Bell pepper
Carrots
Scotch bonnet
Oil
Ginger
½ cup flour
All-purpose seasoning or Maggi signature pottage spice
steps:
Boil chicken with onion, thyme, curry, Knorr, salt, stock cube and water.
Add cut potatoes (cut 1 into 3), diced bell pepper and salt.
Add carrot, scotch bonnet, ginger, curry, thyme, salt, 2 tbsp oil, white pepper and a bit more water.
Then add ½ cup flour and all-purpose seasoning or Maggi signature pottage spice.
Boil for a bit.

name: Beef Stir Fry Vegetable
ingredients:
½ cup veg oil
1 scotch bonnet
1 large onion
2 large bell peppers
Ugwu leaf
1 tbsp curry
1 tbsp thyme
Salt to taste
Knorr
steps:
Add veg oil to a pan and allow to heat up.
Add stir fry beef (make sure it's free of fluid) and stir fry for 3 minutes.
Add curry, thyme, salt and Knorr according to taste and stir fry for a bit.
Add chopped onions and stir fry for a bit.
Blend scotch bonnet and bell pepper (don't blend too much).
Add blended mix and stir fry till oil starts to separate from the sauce.
Wash and drain ugwu vegetable, then chop up, add to sauce and stir for a few seconds.
Take off heat.

name: Jollof Rice (New)
ingredients:
⅔ cup of oil
2 onions
4 cups rice (parboiled)
Curry, thyme
White pepper
Salt
2 bay leaves
3 tbsp tomato paste
2 cups parboiled blended stew base (tomato, pepper, onions)
2-3 seasoning cubes
Butter (1 tbsp)
4 cups of meat stock
steps:
Blend tomato, pepper and onion, and heat to remove water.
Add ⅔ cup of oil to a pot and heat up.
Add 1 small chopped onion to the oil.
Add 1 tsp each of curry, thyme, white pepper + 2 bay leaves. Leave for a bit.
Add 3 tbsp of tomato paste. Stir fry for 3 mins.
Add 2 cups parboiled blended stew base, 2-3 seasoning cubes and salt. Stir fry for a bit.
Add 4 cups meat stock. Cook for 15 minutes.
Add 4 cups of parboiled rice.
Seal with foil and cook for 30 minutes (don't stir).
Then stir, add onions (chopped) and 1 tbsp of butter.
Cook for 5 minutes.

name: Classic Waffles
ingredients:
250g plain flour
1 tsp salt
4 tsps baking powder
2 tbsps caster sugar
1 tsp vanilla extract
75g butter, melted
355ml warm milk
2 eggs
steps:
Mix flour, salt, baking powder and sugar in a bowl.
In a separate bowl beat eggs, stir in milk, butter and vanilla.
Pour this mix into the flour mixture. Beat until blended.
Heat up waffle maker, add 1 tsp butter till they melt, pour in batter and cook.

name: Shawarma
ingredients:
Flat bread
Tomatoes, cucumber
Red onions
Cabbage / lettuce
Carrots
Bell pepper
Ketchup, mayo
Dry pepper
Foil paper
Chicken breast
Salt, Knorr cube
Curry, thyme
(Garlic salt, onion powder)
Chillies
Lemon juice
Water
For sauce mix: ketchup, mayo, yaji, Maggi, lemon
steps:
Marinade chicken breast (30 mins - 24 hrs).
Add 2 tbsp of oil to frying pan, let it heat, place chicken on pan. Fry on each side for 2 mins.
Cover 1 min, make knife incisions on chicken.
Oven it till it cooks (grill setting).
Cut the chicken into thick strips.
Chop the veggies (onions in rings, cucumber and tomatoes in circles, cabbage in strips and carrot in strips as long as your finger).
Heat flat bread for a bit (like 30 secs) on frying pan, bring it out, place it on large piece of foil.
Lay veggies in whichever order you wish (don't put too much otherwise the wrap won't close properly).
Put chicken on top and put the sauce mix over it (you can sprinkle dry pepper).
Roll wrap gently, cover both ends, then roll foil over it and seal both ends.
Grill for about 5 mins.

name: Moist Banana Loaf
ingredients:
100g butter
2 ripe banana
225g self-raising flour
175g caster sugar
2 eggs
1 teaspoon baking powder
3 tablespoons milk
Almond flakes
steps:
Beat all ingredients.
Grease loaf and line with baking paper.
Preheat oven to 180°C.
Pour all ingredients into loaf and bake for 45 mins.

name: Oven Grilled Tilapia
ingredients:
1 tilapia fish, large
½ tsp curry powder
Thyme
2 seasoning cubes
1 scotch bonnet
1 onion, small
5 cloves garlic
½ inch ginger root
2-½ tbsp oil
1 tsp black pepper
Salt to taste
1 African nutmeg
steps:
Clean fish with salt water or lime.
Make marinade — combine/blend all ingredients.
Make 3 deep cuts or more on fish.
Brush marinade over fish, cover every corner including the deep cuts.
Cover up fish and place in fridge for at least 20 min.
Remove, cover in foil, rub it again with marinade and place in 175°C preheated oven for the first 15 mins.
After 15 mins, flip it over, rub it with some marinade again and leave for 15 min.
Leave to cook for another 10 mins.
notes: No. 62 in the book — she sketched the timing cycle: 10 → 15 → 15 → 10.

name: Sugar Cookies
ingredients:
2¾ cups all purpose flour
1 tsp baking soda
½ tsp baking powder
1 cup butter, softened
1½ cups white sugar
1 egg
1 tsp vanilla extract
steps:
Preheat oven to 190°C.
In a small bowl — stir together flour, baking soda and baking powder. Set aside.
In a large bowl — cream butter and sugar until smooth. Beat in egg and vanilla. Blend in dry ingredients.
Roll rounded teaspoonfuls of dough into balls, and place onto ungreased cookie sheets.
Bake 8-10 mins in the preheated oven, or until golden.

name: African Okro Soup
ingredients:
One pound okra, fresh or frozen
Meat or dry meat
½ pound shrimp
1 onion (chopped)
½ cup ground crayfish
1 tablespoon beef / chicken bouillon
Chopped spinach
1 tbsp smoked paprika / red pepper flakes
½ cup ground egusi
Salt & pepper to taste
steps:
Boil meat in pot with garlic, salt, pepper, onions or paprika.
(If using fresh okra, wash it, remove the tops and tails and slice into rounds.)
Blend okra into a coarse consistency in a food processor or you can chop finely.
Add crayfish, bouillon or Maggi and egusi into pan of boiled meat. Cook for 5 mins.
Then add shrimp, cook for another 5 mins and add spinach (if you're using it).

name: Nigerian Shawarma (2)
ingredients:
Chicken (drumstick)
Onion
Garlic
Atarodo
Sausages ×4 (maybe)
Saltless butter
Mayo
Dry pepper
Habanero
Thyme
Olive oil
Cabbage
Carrot
Cucumber
Ketchup
Lemon
Wrap bread
steps:
Blend ¼ onions, 3 garlic cloves, ½ atarodo.
Add blended mix to chicken with ½ cup of water, 1 tbsp of Knorr, 1 tsp salt and boil — 15 mins?
Boil 4 sausages in one cup of water for 10 mins (no salt or spices).
Cut sausages in half (lengthwise).
Brown some saltless butter in a pan. Sauté the sausages in the butter and set aside.
Decant the excess water left in the chicken pot.
Add 1 tbsp of mayo/Heinz to chicken (and some dry pepper).
Add 1 tsp of habanero hot sauce (or habanero + white vinegar).
Add a dash of thyme, 1 tbsp of olive oil.
Put on grill for 10 mins / bake in oven. Flip on its side and grill properly.
Make coleslaw: chop ¼ onion, cabbage, carrot and cucumber (chop, don't grate).
Make shawarma sauce: 2 tbsp of salad cream/mayo, 1 tbsp ketchup, 1 tspn of habanero, lil bit of lemon/vinegar.
Heat up tortilla in pan.
Shred chicken and put on bread.
Add coleslaw, add a sausage.
Add some shawarma sauce.
Roll it, put on grill.

name: Native Onion Stew
ingredients:
10 onions
1.5 tbsp of crayfish (+ ½ tbsp later)
0.5 tbsp of pepper
1 mackerel
½ cup of palm oil
4 Knorr cubes
2 pinches of salt (¼ tsp)
1 cup of water
steps:
Blend 10 onions.
Add in 1.5 tbsp of crayfish and 0.5 tbsp of pepper to onion blend.
Peel 1 mackerel and break into big chunks.
Heat up ½ cup of palm oil.
Add fish to heated oil and let fry for 4 mins.
Add onion blend to heated oil and ½ tbsp crayfish.
Add 4 Knorr cubes and maybe 0.5 tbsp water.
Add 2 pinches of salt (¼ tsp).
Add 1 cup of water.
Boil for 35 mins and you're done.
